change_summary: Preserve authorized private/confidential selected work in bounded private scopes while keeping true local-only and restricted material outside Corvio; retain the preceding same-operation partial recovery contract.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill and API reference distinguish privacy scope from a local-only transport veto, keep whole selected packets causally complete, and retain typed same-operation recovery.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-17.1 distinguishes private owner and ACL constraints from true restricted or local-only exclusions, while preserving bounded same-operation recovery without moving semantic planning into Runtime.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together to 1.7.60; compatibility family and minimum revision remain unchanged.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace and Admin CLI versions are unchanged and remain compatible with contract 2026-09-17.1.

help_center.note: Public MCP guidance explains private-scope retention, true local-only exclusions, whole-packet reconciliation, and bounded same-operation recovery.

package_setup.note: README, Codex defaults, and SessionStart carry the compact privacy/scope boundary without asking the Host to design the Tree or reinterpret source placement.

harness_and_mainline.note: The mainline records the released-host semantic miss, preserves full-body compatibility and total-work routing, and keeps Runtime as typed execution and receipt owner.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party publication, public hashes and fresh released-host readback remain release gates; external directory acceptance stays outside repository authority.

release_evidence.note: Source guards, typed recovery receipts, the 30-turn ambient Work Model portfolio and live Codex samples cover causal intake, topology, one-shot recovery and ROI; fresh released-host and Claude readback remain live gates.
